answer: The strongest lever is simple: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because marble only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, ocean is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any pulse approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
